operation_details.item: The user uses precedent transactions in valuation work.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: How’s the valuation work going today?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Pretty well. I’m updating a valuation memo and reviewing the key assumptions.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Are you still using discounted cash flow as the primary approach?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Yes, DCF is my primary valuation method. I also use comparable company multiples as a cross-check.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Do you bring any transaction data into the analysis as well?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: I use precedent transactions in my valuation work too, especially when I want another market-based perspective.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: That gives you a useful set of perspectives. How do you keep the methodology clear for reviewers?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: I document all valuation assumptions in the memo, along with how each method supports the conclusion.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Forget only that I use precedent transactions, while keeping the DCF, comps, and assumptions documentation.
